title: ZepTeach global config
description: Written by setup stage 1 (identity, notes, teaching language, persona, agent models). Per-course environment preparation is setup stage 2 and lives in course.environment, not here.

teaching_language.description: Language ZepTeach teaches in. NEVER defaulted or inferred; setup stage 1 must ask the user. A course may override it.

notes.description: Notes are written twice, for two different readers. The markdown copy is what this plugin reads back: plain text, linkable, diffable, and the thing a later lesson searches to find what was already established. The document copy is what the learner reads: the same content, laid out to be read rather than parsed. Neither is a export of the other at write time; both are produced from the same note, so they cannot drift apart. No particular notes application is assumed. Pointing markdown_dir at a folder some other tool already watches works because it is a folder of markdown files, which is all this plugin needs to know.

markdown_dir.description: Where the canonical markdown notes live. This is the copy the plugin reads.

document_dir.description: Where the readable documents go. Absent means the learner only wants the markdown.

document_format.description: docx by default when document_dir is set.

journal_dir.description: Where the running record of what was discussed goes, kept apart from the canonical notes. Mixing the two is what turns notes into a diary.

address_user.description: How Zep addresses the learner. Empty string means no form of address.

closeness.description: 1=formal colleague, 5=close labmate. Affects tone only, NEVER standards.

banter.description: 0=none, 3=frequent. Auto-suppressed when declared energy is low.

api_key_env.description: NAME of the env var holding the key. The key itself is never stored in this file.

review_cap_per_session.description: Most review items one session will take on. A wall of overdue items is the documented reason people abandon spaced repetition, and reviewing late costs very little retention, so the debt is worked off at a steady rate instead of cleared in one sitting.

retire_after_instant.description: Consecutive instant recalls after which a mastered concept leaves the review queue.
